title: The tempting alternative, and what it actually returns
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map (if ($.status == "active") $.name else null)

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map (if ($.status == "active") $.name else null)

explanation.approach: `map` always returns one element per input element — it cannot drop anything. The rejected rows come back as nulls and the array is still length 3. This is the single most common way this task is got wrong.
